Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses two proteomics approaches: an affinity-capture (AP-MS) to find interaction partners of the CDR2 peptide and a quantitative label-free DDA proteomics run to compare treated vs untreated retinal explants. The acquisition is clearly DDA based on the 'five most intense precursor ions' and 'dynamic exclusion' settings. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome) was performed, although the discussion mentions PTM sites of the target protein.

scope: The main goal of the present study was to identify direct retinal interaction partners of synthetic CDR2 using affinity capture mass spectrometry (AC-MS)
For the identification of CDR2-specific interaction partners, the synthetic peptide Biotin-[Acp]-INSDGSSTSYADSVK was immobilized on Pierce™ Streptavidin Magnetic Beads
the remaining attached proteins were eluted with 100 μL of Pierce™ IgG Elution buffer pH 2.0
the eluate fractions were screened for potential protein interaction partners by LC-MS analysis

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed two types of MS analysis: one using affinity capture (immunoprecipitation) to identify interaction partners of the CDR2 peptide, and another quantitative analysis of retinal explants. Following the precedence rules, the affinity-purified material (purified protein or complex) is prioritized over the whole tissue/lysate analysis.
